name: UAL 182 火山灰 双发失效 一发重启不稳定

cards.audioText: B: Your aircraft call sign is United 182, you are at the holding point of runway 04, call Wuhan Tower you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的航空器呼号是 United 182，在跑道 04 等待点，呼叫武汉塔台，报告准备起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL182, holding point of runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL182，跑道 04 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: United 182, behind China Southern Boeing 777 on short final, line up behind runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 182，在短五边 China Southern Boeing 777 后，跟随其后进入跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Behind CSN B777 on short final, line up behind runway 04, UAL182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随短五边 CSN B777 后进入跑道 04，UAL182。

cards.audioText: C: United 182, when airborne, turn right heading 070, climb to 3000 meters, cleared for immediate takeoff runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 182，离地后右转航向 070，爬升至 3000 米，跑道 04 可以立即起飞。
cards.referenceText: When airborne, turn right heading 070, climb to 3000 meters, cleared for immediate takeoff runway 04, UAL182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离地后右转航向 070，爬升至 3000 米，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，UAL182。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne and passing 200 meters, call Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已离地，通过 200 米，呼叫武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL182, airborne, passing 200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL182，已离地，通过 200 米。

cards.audioText: C: United 182, after passing 1200 meters, turn left direct to Zulu Foxtrot.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 182，通过 1200 米后左转直飞 Zulu Foxtrot。
cards.referenceText: After passing 1200 meters, turn left direct to ZF, UAL182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过 1200 米后左转直飞 ZF，UAL182。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are in London Control area, FL350, you encountered volcanic ash, tell ATC the situation and request descent, call London Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在伦敦管制区，飞行高度层 350，遭遇火山灰，向 ATC 报告情况并请求下降，呼叫伦敦管制。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL182, we encountered volcanic ash at FL350, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL182，我们在 FL350 遭遇火山灰，请求下降。

cards.audioText: C: United 182, turn right heading 300, descend to FL290.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 182，右转航向 300，下降至飞行高度层 290。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, descend to FL290, UAL182.

cards.audioText: B: Tell ATC you are still in volcanic ash area, both engines are vibrating highly, but aircraft can still be controlled.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉 ATC 你仍在火山灰区域，双发振动严重，但飞机仍可操控。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL182, we are still in volcanic ash area, both engines are vibrating highly, but aircraft can still be controlled.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL182，我们仍在火山灰区域，双发振动严重，但飞机仍可操控。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, both engines flamed out, make a Distress call and request land at the nearest airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中，双发熄火，发出遇险呼叫并请求在最近机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, London Control, UAL182, both engines flamed out, request land at the nearest airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，伦敦管制，UAL182，双发熄火，请求在最近机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: United 182, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 340.
B: 1 engine was successfully restarted during descent, tell ATC the situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中 1 台发动机成功重启，告诉 ATC 当前情况。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL182, 1 engine was successfully restarted during descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL182，下降过程中 1 台发动机成功重启。

cards.audioText:
C: United 182, what's your intention?
B: Tell ATC you still need to land at the nearest airport because the running engine is not stable.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：United 182，你的意图？
B：告诉 ATC 因工作发动机不稳定，仍需在最近机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL182, request land at the nearest airport due the running engine is not stable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL182，因工作发动机不稳定，请求在最近机场着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: United 182, continue descent to 9000 feet, expect to land at Beatle Airport.
B: Tell controller you are not familiar with Beatle Airport, request airport information.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：United 182，继续下降至 9000 英尺，预计在 Beatle Airport 着陆。
B：告诉管制员你不熟悉 Beatle Airport，请求机场信息。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to 9000 feet, we are not familiar with Beatle Airport, request airport information, UAL182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降至 9000 英尺，我们不熟悉 Beatle Airport，请求机场信息，UAL182。

cards.audioText:
C: United 182, Beatle Airport landing runway 02, elevation 2000 feet, runway 3000 meters long, 45 meters wide, ILS CAT I and II available.
B: Tell ATC you are able to land at this airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：United 182，Beatle Airport 使用着陆跑道 02，机场标高 2000 英尺，跑道长 3000 米、宽 45 米，可用 ILS CAT I 和 II。
B：告诉 ATC 你可以在该机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL182, we are able to land at this airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL182，我们可以在该机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: United 182, continue descent to 5000 feet and contact Approach 121.3.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 182，继续下降至 5000 英尺，联系进近 121.3。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to 5000 feet and contact Approach 121.3, UAL182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降至 5000 英尺，联系进近 121.3，UAL182。

cards.audioText: B: Contact Approach, tell them your emergency situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B：联系进近，告知他们你的紧急情况。
cards.referenceText: Approach, UAL182, we encountered volcanic ash, both engines flamed out, 1 engine was successfully restarted but not stable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，UAL182，我们遭遇火山灰，双发熄火，1 台发动机已成功重启但不稳定。

cards.audioText:
C: United 182, roger your situation, runway is at your 2 o'clock, 10 miles, report airfield in sight.
B: Tell ATC you see the airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：United 182，收到你的情况，跑道在你 2 点钟方向 10 海里，看到机场后报告。
B：告诉 ATC 你看到机场。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Approach you need emergency services to be ready near the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉进近你需要应急服务在跑道附近待命。
cards.referenceText: Approach, UAL182, request emergency services to be ready near the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，UAL182，请求应急服务在跑道附近待命。
